name: codex-discord-channel
description: Claude-style Discord channel ownership for Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver one Discord bot inbox to the current Codex TUI.
interface.longDescription: A state-directory-owned Discord channel plugin for Codex. It persistently queues accepted inbound messages and delivers them to the current TUI without treating Codex session or thread identifiers as durable identity.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-discord-channel to check Discord channel status.
Check the durable Discord bot inbox for this instance.
Send a receipt-aware Discord reply from the current Codex TUI.
